name: leucine twenty homeobox
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: LEUTX encodes paired-like homeodomain transcription factor LEUTX. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS CIC-rearranged sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
